name: manual_0f66a3
claim: When temporarily repointing a git submodule's .gitmodules url at your own fork to consume not-yet-merged upstream PRs, document the temporary state and exact revert path in at least 3 places -- an inline comment in .gitmodules itself, the vendor-tracking doc's current-pin section, and any blend-state or catalog file's note field -- and validate end-to-end via a real fresh-clone plus git submodule update --init, not just the url change alone.

decisions.notes: Used to pin PT's vendor/agentic-stack to a fork commit (upstream master plus 3 own PRs plus a found-in-blend 4th fix) pending upstream merge; the 3-place documentation ensures the temporary state is never silently forgotten, and the fork url is reverted once all PRs land.

rationale: Used to pin PT's vendor/agentic-stack to a fork commit (upstream master plus 3 own PRs plus a found-in-blend 4th fix) pending upstream merge; the 3-place documentation ensures the temporary state is never silently forgotten, and the fork url is reverted once all PRs land.
